name: @domily/next-dom-host
description: Experimental end-to-end browser host for Domily Next documents

scripts.build: rm -rf ./lib && bun build ./src/index.ts --outdir ./lib --target browser --format esm --external @domily/next-ast --external @domily/next-loader --external @domily/next-renderer-dom --external @domily/next-runtime --external @domily/next-validator && tsc -b ./tsconfig.types.json --force
